svg.title: Resident recurrent-state storage on Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base
svg.desc: At batch one, FP32 recurrent states occupy 18,874,368 bytes. Uniform INT4 with FP16 scales occupies 2,433,024 bytes, 7.758 times smaller. Keeping layer zero at INT8 and the other 17 layers at INT4 occupies 2,564,096 bytes, 7.361 times smaller. These are persistent state bytes only, not whole-model or peak memory.
